about.title: Welcome to JD Hardware
about.intro: At JD Hardware, we believe finding the right products for your home, garden, workspace and everyday needs should be straightforward, convenient and reliable.
about.body: Operated by JD Hardware Co., JD Hardware is a UK-based online retail store offering a diverse selection of products across home improvement, outdoor living, power equipment, heating, wellness, electronics and gaming.

values.title: Wide Product Selection
values.text: Explore products across multiple categories without needing to visit several specialist stores.

values.title: Free UK Delivery
values.text: We offer free standard shipping throughout the United Kingdom, with no standard delivery charge.

values.title: Clear Delivery Estimates
values.text: Our standard estimated delivery period is 4–7 business days, including order handling and carrier transit.

values.title: 28-Day Returns
values.text: Eligible products may be returned within 28 days, including qualifying non-defective returns.

values.title: Free Return Shipping
values.text: We provide return labels for approved returns at no additional charge.

values.title: No Restocking Fees
values.text: Approved returns are not subject to restocking fees.

values.title: Customer Assistance
values.text: Our customer support team is available through our published contact channels, including 24/7 live chat.

sections.title: Who We Are
paragraphs: JD Hardware is a multi-category online retailer serving customers throughout the United Kingdom.
We understand that purchasing products online requires trust. Customers need accurate product descriptions, transparent prices, clear delivery expectations and straightforward return procedures.
Our approach is built around making this information accessible throughout the shopping experience.

sections.title: Our Mission
paragraphs: Our mission is to offer customers a convenient online shopping experience supported by clear product information, transparent policies and accessible customer assistance.

Why Shop at JD Hardware?

sections.title: Our Commitment to Customers
paragraphs: We aim to provide clear communication from the moment customers explore a product until their order has been delivered.
If a problem occurs, we encourage customers to contact our support team so we can review the matter and provide appropriate assistance.

commitment.title: Our Commitment to a Clear and Reliable Shopping Experience
commitment.intro: At JD Hardware, operated by JD Hardware Co., we recognise that customers expect accurate information, transparent pricing and straightforward assistance when shopping online.
commitment.body: Our commitment is to make the shopping process as clear and convenient as possible.

sections.title: 1. Product Information
paragraphs: We aim to provide useful product descriptions, images, specifications and purchasing details.
Customers are encouraged to review product dimensions, compatibility, installation requirements and manufacturer instructions before ordering.

sections.title: 2. Transparent Pricing
paragraphs: Our product prices are displayed in pounds sterling (GBP).
We aim to disclose applicable charges before an order is placed.
Standard delivery within the United Kingdom is free.

sections.title: 3. Free UK Shipping
paragraphs: We provide free standard shipping throughout the United Kingdom.
Our published delivery estimates are:
Our standard order cut-off is 5:00 PM UK local time.

sections.title: 4. Clear Returns and Refunds
paragraphs: Eligible products may be returned within 28 days under our Return Policy.
We accept qualifying defective and non-defective returns.
Approved returns include:
We aim to process eligible refunds within 10 days after the return has been received and approved, subject to applicable statutory requirements.

sections.title: 5. Customer Support
paragraphs: Our customer support channels are available for assistance with:
Live chat is available 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

sections.title: 6. Responsible Product Information
paragraphs: Some products, including power equipment, fireplaces, wood stoves, electrical equipment and saunas, require particular safety precautions.
Customers should follow manufacturer instructions and applicable installation, electrical, building and fire safety requirements.

sections.title: 7. Privacy and Security
paragraphs: We recognise the importance of customer privacy.
Our Privacy Policy explains how personal information may be collected, used and protected.

sections.title: 8. Respect for Consumer Rights
paragraphs: Our store policies are intended to operate alongside applicable UK consumer protection laws.
Nothing in our policies is intended to remove or restrict statutory rights.

sections.title: 9. Continuous Improvement
paragraphs: We welcome customer feedback and aim to improve our website, product information and customer assistance.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Welcome to the JD Hardware Help Centre. Find answers to common questions about products, orders, shipping, returns, refunds and customer support.

items.question: What is JD Hardware?
items.answer: JD Hardware is a UK online retail store operated by JD Hardware Co., offering products across home improvement, outdoor living, power equipment, heating, electronics and gaming.

items.question: Where is JD Hardware located?
items.answer: Our business address is 280A Norwood Road, Norwood, London SE27 9AJ, United Kingdom.

items.question: What products do you sell?
items.answer: Our categories include lawn and garden products, outdoor power equipment, fireplaces, wood stoves, saunas, computer equipment, gaming consoles and home improvement products.

items.question: How can I contact JD Hardware?
items.answer: Email info@jdhardware.shop or telephone 020 7606 3333.

items.question: Is live chat available?
items.answer: Yes. Our live chat is available 24/7.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Select your products, add them to your basket and follow the checkout instructions.

items.question: What currency do you use?
items.answer: Our store uses pounds sterling (GBP).

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: The payment methods currently available are displayed during checkout.

items.question: Can I cancel an order?
items.answer: Contact us as soon as possible if you wish to cancel. Your statutory cancellation rights may apply even after an order has entered fulfilment.

items.question: Can I change my delivery address?
items.answer: Contact support immediately. Address changes may not be possible after dispatch.

items.question: Where do you deliver?
items.answer: We currently deliver within the United Kingdom only.

items.question: Do you offer international delivery?
items.answer: No. International shipping is not currently available.

items.question: How much does shipping cost?
items.answer: Standard shipping is free throughout the United Kingdom.

items.question: What is your order cut-off time?
items.answer: 5:00 PM UK local time.

items.question: How long does order processing take?
items.answer: Typically 1–2 business days.

items.question: How long does delivery take after dispatch?
items.answer: Estimated transit time is 3–5 business days.

items.question: What is the total estimated delivery time?
items.answer: Approximately 4–7 business days.

items.question: What are your business days?
items.answer: Monday through Friday, excluding applicable UK bank holidays.

items.question: Will I receive tracking information?
items.answer: Where tracking is available, it may be provided after dispatch.

items.question: What if my order is delayed?
items.answer: Contact customer support with your order number and delivery information.

items.question: What if my parcel arrives damaged?
items.answer: Contact us promptly with photographs and your order information where possible.

items.question: What is your return window?
items.answer: 28 days for eligible returns under our standard store policy.

items.question: Can I return a product if I change my mind?
items.answer: Yes, eligible non-defective products can be returned under the applicable conditions.

items.question: Do you accept defective returns?
items.answer: Yes. Statutory rights relating to faulty goods also apply.

items.question: Are returns free?
items.answer: Yes. We provide return labels for approved returns at no additional charge.

items.question: Do you charge restocking fees?
items.answer: No. Our restocking fee is £0.00.

items.question: Do you offer exchanges?
items.answer: No. Direct exchanges are not currently available.

items.question: How do I request a return?
items.answer: Contact info@jdhardware.shop with your order number and reason for return.

items.question: How long do refunds take?
items.answer: We aim to process eligible refunds within 10 days after the returned product is received and approved, subject to statutory requirements.

items.question: How will I receive my refund?
items.answer: Approved refunds are normally issued to the original payment method.

items.question: Does your return policy affect my statutory rights?
items.answer: No. Applicable UK consumer rights remain unaffected.

items.question: Do products come with a warranty?
items.answer: Warranty coverage depends on the product and any applicable manufacturer warranty.

items.question: Do you provide installation?
items.answer: Installation is not included unless specifically stated in the product listing.

items.question: Can I ask about product compatibility?
items.answer: Yes. Contact us with the product details before purchasing.
